warning: Prototype review bridge only. Tickets are browser-side review aids, not scholar approval, canonical source validation, production workflow, therapy, ritual instruction, emergency support, or spiritual authority.
ticket_policy: Create visible review tickets for failed evals, review-needed source matches, and no-source gaps. Passing answer-ready cases are monitored but do not become open review work.

lanes.label: Eval failure
lanes.next_action: Compare expected and actual source, then decide whether the data, scoring rule, or expectation should change.

lanes.label: Source review
lanes.next_action: Confirm citation, source family, rights state, and whether the answer can move from review-needed to answer-ready.

lanes.label: Mantra review
lanes.next_action: Review Sanskrit, recitation boundary, ritual caution, and citation-only wording before public answer use.

lanes.label: Commentary review
lanes.next_action: Add comparison lanes so one tradition is not flattened into the only reading.

lanes.label: Source gap
lanes.next_action: Record the user question, likely claim family, and missing evidence without forcing an answer.
